title: Fix round-1 pointer delivery loss under parallel herding spawns
action: Investigate the bee-bin-refresh incident (round-1 pointer never reached the agy pane spawned in parallel with bhv-1-r1; keystrokes echoed above the boot banner; run waited toward ceiling with an undelivered brief) and fix the delivery/receipt defect in run.rs, keeping the contracts: one-line pointer, bounded re-sends, agent-caused-state-transition receipt, typed failure when attempts run out. Tests in existing run.rs style cover the found failure mode.

truths: An undelivered brief can no longer ride silently to ceiling
Receipt still requires an agent-caused state transition
